activity.role: Chairman of the Ukrainian Central Rada
activity.notes: Hrushevsky chaired the Central Rada. ATLAS does not label him 'first President of Ukraine', a later popular misdescription. This Activity begins with the Third Universal's proclamation of the Ukrainian People's Republic and ends with the overthrow of the Central Rada on 29 April 1918.

sources.title: Ukrainian Institute of National Memory — Mykhailo Hrushevsky was not the first President of Ukraine
sources.citation_text: The institute explains that Hrushevsky was Chairman of the Central Rada through 29 April 1918 and rejects the retrospective title 'first president'.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Central Rada
sources.citation_text: The Central Rada proclaimed the Ukrainian People's Republic by its Third Universal in November 1917 and remained its central representative body until the Hetman coup of April 1918.
